description: What is AppScreens? AppScreens is an app store screenshot generator built for teams that need polished, localized, store-ready screenshots without losing hours to manual design, resizing, translation, exports, and uploads. Why app teams use it Instead of rebuilding every screenshot size by hand, AppScreens lets you create one editable project and generate the assets needed for App Store, Google Play, feature graphics, tablets, phones, custom sizes, and localized store listings.
